pillars.name: card precision + C8 maturity
pillars.rule: mtime-window provenance: a file whose mtime lies inside one of this session's shell tool-call windows after its last own edit is unknown, not foreign; pre-session foreign hunks stay foreign (arm C must stay 2/2 GREEN). Gate replays the 5 live false denies (300ac3a1, 5b36b02f x2, 3a05f288, 4a7ee8bc) as allowed AND keeps a pre-session foreign hunk denied; the 'git exit 128' x6 class is root-caused and named. C8 target is a delivery card (deny-once question), never an authority.

pillars.name: listing floor + plugin gateway + economics
pillars.rule: listing hiding was falsified twice (C6, K4) against D-LISTING; a third hypothesis closes this pillar only with its own measurement against D-LISTING recording the command; a lower floor claimed without a fresh-session measurement is refused

pillars.name: opportunity / delivery / recall / precision
pillars.rule: opportunity, delivery, recall and precision are computed by one gate from transcripts over a named window; recall and precision report n and are never extrapolated from n < 5

pillars.name: coverage + criticality
pillars.rule: every installed skill gets a coverage class (opportunity detector / card / none) and a criticality class from a discovered sweep, never a hand list

pillars.name: contribution + result consumption
pillars.rule: contribution is claimed only from a paired benchmark inside the <= 10 new-session budget (D-SESSIONS); otherwise the measurement records why the budget cannot separate the arms

pillars.name: disclosure / fission / fusion / inline / dedup
pillars.rule: each representation operation applied to a skill carries a before/after listing measurement against D-LISTING and a recall check; dedup decisions come from a content-hash sweep

pillars.name: compile-out + lineage
pillars.rule: a compiled-out card names the skill and commit it was compiled from, and a gate fails when the source skill changes without the card being re-derived

pillars.name: freshness / drift / recert
pillars.rule: drift between a skill's live copy and its repo mirror, and between a card and its source, is detected by a gate driven from both poles

pillars.name: lifecycle / retirement / self-pruning / GC
pillars.rule: merged into cognitive-economy pillar T; this program hands over its retirement candidates with evidence and deletes nothing

pillars.name: creation governance
pillars.rule: a new skill must declare its opportunity detector or why it has none; a gate refuses a skill directory without the declaration

pillars.name: capability routing + ACV
pillars.rule: routing lives with ACV; this program contributes opportunity rows through CO-12 and builds no second router

pillars.name: CO-12 + Context Compiler
pillars.rule: the Context Compiler is ABSENT; it is deferred to the cognitive-economy program with a handoff; CO-12 is written only through record_signal

pillars.name: economics / model / goal relativity
pillars.rule: cost figures come from tools/usage_index.py windows; this program reports token and turn deltas relative to a named denominator and owns no cost model

pillars.name: CBR / UBC / UKDL / settings / push closeout
pillars.rule: closeout: UKDL and CBR reviews exist, global settings equal the declared retained state (wrapper --final check), and push happens only once no foreign commits interleave (Owner boundary 4)

D-LISTING.caveat: fresh-session first-call figures; one session each, n=1 per arm

D-CARD.source: doctrine card ledger, live sessions after K1 bf3d526a
